top_signals.title: Record India Sugar Prices Spur Mills to Advance Cane Crushing
top_signals.summary: Indian sugar producers are set to start crushing cane earlier than usual in the upcoming milling season as the government seeks to bolster supplies and rein in record prices ahead of the festival period.
